$description: Aurora - a heyrav world. base: any theme; light/dark: per theme; voice: words reworded in this world. Keys are token names without the --.
name: Aurora
line: A polar sky: glass panels over light that moves, and answers the pointer.

voice.copyfail: Lost in the static - select the code instead
voice.hero.p: Every token, component and pattern behind heyrav.in, set in glass over a sky that never sits still - and leans toward the pointer.
voice.lede.worlds: One system, many skies. The same components, lit differently: type, colour, shape, depth and motion change with one touch.
voice.lede.typography: Unbounded draws the titles wide and open, like a horizon. Manrope carries the reading; Space Mono keeps the labels and numbers steady.
voice.lede.colour: A polar night: deep blue-black, with sea-green, sky-blue and violet only where light falls. By day, ice and slate.
voice.lede.spacing: Wide and unhurried: a tenth more space around everything, so the light has room.
voice.lede.radius: Soft, generous corners, like ice worn smooth.
voice.lede.elevation: Panels are frosted glass; their height is a glow behind them, not a shadow under them.
voice.lede.motion: Slow and smooth, like the sky. Long ease-outs, nothing snaps - and reduced motion stills the sky entirely.
voice.lede.icons: Phosphor Light: thin strokes that sit quietly on glass.
voice.lede.button: Light, gathered into a pill. The gradient drifts under the pointer; a success sends a flare across the sky.
voice.lede.voice: Calm and spacious. Few words, plainly put, the way instruments speak.
voice.lede.404: Nothing out here but sky. Search, or head back to the first page.
voice.type.head: titles
voice.type.head.note: Unbounded at a light weight: wide, open, unhurried.
voice.type.sans.note: Manrope: clean and calm at every size.
voice.type.em.note: Manrope at a light weight, coloured by the sky behind it.
voice.type.label: labels
voice.type.mono.note: Space Mono: steady as an instrument.
voice.lede.chip: Frosted glass. Chosen, it fills with gathered light and casts a glow beneath.
voice.lede.badge: Glass with tracked letters; a live dot glows rather than blinks.
voice.lede.card: Frosted glass that lights at its edge wherever the pointer is.
voice.lede.input: Glass at rest. With focus, a ring of moving light runs round its edge.
voice.lede.checkbox: Ticked boxes glow, faintly, in the colour of the sky.
voice.lede.switch: An orb on a glass rail; on, the rail fills with light.
voice.lede.slider: The filled part of the track runs sea-green to violet; the thumb glows.
voice.lede.tabs: The chosen tab trails a line of light that spills a little below it.
voice.lede.accordion: A glowing mark turns as the answer opens, slowly.
voice.lede.dialog: Glass over a dimmed, blurred sky, with a line of light along its top; it rises out of focus into place.
voice.lede.tooltip: A small pane of frosted glass.
voice.lede.progress: A ribbon of aurora with a bright head.
voice.lede.spinner: A ring of light chasing itself.
voice.lede.skeleton: Northern light drifting across where content will be.
voice.lede.avatar: A hairline ring and a soft glow.
voice.lede.link: Ink over a sea-green rule; under the pointer the word glows.
voice.lede.menu: Glass, a line of light along the top, a glow on the item in focus.
voice.lede.morph: Sync: a glowing ring while it works, a soft green glow In sync, then the signal opens - and a flare crosses the sky.
